name: What Beats Learning
install:
npm ci
if [ ! -f .dev.vars ]; then sed "s|^COOKIE_ENCRYPTION_KEY=.*|COOKIE_ENCRYPTION_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)|" .dev.vars.example > .dev.vars; fi

terminals.name: wrangler dev
terminals.description: Local Cloudflare Workers dev server for the What Beats Learning MCP on http://localhost:8788. Uses --local so the remote-only Workers AI binding does not require a CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN; generate_image (Workers AI) is unavailable locally, but every other route and MCP tool works.
